metadata.name: jpui-rich-text-editor
metadata.description: A TipTap-based rich text editor whose formatting toolbar is a floating dropzone shown on text selection; buttons dropped inside are wired to the editor actions.
features: Floating selection toolbar built as a customizable dropzone
Formatting actions: bold, italic, underline, strike, headings, lists, quote, code, color, font, link
Smart menu placement with auto-flip and offset controls
Live selection state exposed for active-state buttons
HTML value output and change/focus/blur/selectionChange events

properties.name: ariaLabel
properties.description: Accessible name of the editing area, announced by screen readers.

properties.name: toolbarLabel
properties.description: Accessible name of the floating toolbar.

properties.name: focusRingColor
properties.description: Color of the ring drawn when the editor is focused by keyboard.

properties.name: initialValue
properties.description: Initial HTML content of the editor.

properties.name: placeholder
properties.description: Placeholder shown when the editor is empty.

properties.name: editable
properties.description: Allow the user to edit the content.

properties.name: forceOpenMenu
properties.description: Editor mode only: keep the floating toolbar open to drop/arrange buttons.

properties.name: menuVerticalPosition
properties.description: Floating menu vertical position: top | bottom.

properties.name: menuHorizontalPosition
properties.description: Floating menu horizontal position: left | center | right.

properties.name: menuAutoFlip
properties.description: Flip the menu to the opposite side when it would overflow the viewport.

properties.name: menuOffsetX
properties.description: Horizontal offset of the floating menu.

properties.name: menuOffsetY
properties.description: Vertical offset of the floating menu.

properties.name: menuZIndex
properties.description: Stacking order of the floating toolbar, which is rendered at the page root.

properties.name: blockquoteBar
properties.description: CSS border shorthand for the vertical bar on the left of a quote.

properties.name: blockquoteBackground
properties.description: Background color of the quote block. Empty for none.

properties.name: blockquotePadding
properties.description: Padding inside the quote block; the left value is the gap between the bar and the text.

properties.name: blockquoteMarginLeft
properties.description: Quote margin applied as margin-inline-start (direction-aware). Defaults to the 40px browsers use for quotes.

properties.name: blockquoteMarginRight
properties.description: Quote margin applied as margin-inline-end (direction-aware). Defaults to the 40px browsers use for quotes.

properties.name: linkTextDecoration
properties.description: Text decoration for links: underline | none | line-through | overline.

properties.name: codeBackground
properties.description: Background color of code blocks and inline code.

properties.name: fieldName
properties.description: Name of the field in the submission data. Only shown inside a form; falls back to the element name.

properties.name: customValidation
properties.description: Enable a custom validation formula for this form field. Only shown inside a form.

properties.name: validation
properties.description: Validation formula evaluated before submit, when customValidation is on.

states.name: focus
states.description: Emitted while the editing area has focus. Style properties marked state-aware can be given focus values.

states.name: readonly
states.description: Emitted while the editor is read-only via the Read only property or Editable off. Excludes the editor-canvas read-only override, so the state is not pinned on while designing.

events.name: initValueChange
events.description: Fires when the bound initial value changes from outside the component.

events.name: focus
events.description: Fires when the editor gains focus.

events.name: blur
events.description: Fires when the editor loses focus.

localContext.name: richText
localContext.description: Live editor/selection state, available to elements inside the toolbar dropzone (and other descendants) as context.local.data['richText']. Updates on every selection and content change.

properties.name: isBold
properties.description: True when the selection is bold.

properties.name: isItalic
properties.description: True when the selection is italic.

properties.name: isUnderline
properties.description: True when the selection is underlined.

properties.name: isStrike
properties.description: True when the selection is struck through.

properties.name: isCode
properties.description: True when the selection is inline code.

properties.name: isCodeBlock
properties.description: True when the block is a code block.

properties.name: isBulletList
properties.description: True when in a bullet list.

properties.name: isOrderedList
properties.description: True when in an ordered list.

properties.name: isLink
properties.description: True when the selection is a link.

properties.name: currentHeadingLevel
properties.description: Heading level of the block (0 = paragraph).

properties.name: linkHref
properties.description: Href of the current link, or null.

properties.name: hasSelection
properties.description: True when there is a non-empty selection.

properties.name: isEmpty
properties.description: True when the editor is empty.

actions.label: Toggle inline code
actions.description: Toggle inline code on the selection.

actions.label: Set paragraph
actions.description: Convert the block to a paragraph.

actions.label: Close toolbar
actions.description: Hide the floating toolbar until the next selection.

slots.name: toolbarContent
slots.description: Dropzone for the floating selection toolbar. Drop buttons/icons here and wire each to one of the component actions; read context.local.data['richText'] (or the "state" variable) to show active states.

variables.name: state
variables.description: Live formatting state of the current selection (same fields as the richText local context).

specifications: The formatting toolbar is not built in: drop your own buttons into the toolbarContent dropzone and wire them to the actions.
The floating menu appears on text selection; in the WeWeb editor it stays open when forceOpenMenu is on so you can arrange buttons.
Selection state is exposed twice: context.local.data['richText'] (instance-relative, for elements inside the dropzone) and the global "state" variable (variables['<uid>-state']).
Output is HTML via the "value" variable and the change event.
Per-element-type typography is controlled by the style properties grouped by element (Paragraph, Heading 1-6, Quote, Code, Lists, Link).

Works as a form field inside a ww-form-container: the HTML value is submitted under fieldName, validated before submit, and reset to initialValue with the form. Outside a form it behaves as a standalone editor and the form settings stay hidden.
The editor is read-only on the WeWeb editor canvas, since typing there is never persisted; it edits normally in preview and at runtime.

At runtime the floating toolbar is teleported to the page root and positioned with position: fixed, so it is never clipped by an ancestor overflow and never trapped in a parent stacking context; use menuZIndex to layer it against app overlays. On the editor canvas it stays inside the component so WeWeb drag & drop into the dropzone keeps working.

Accessibility: the editing area is role=textbox with aria-multiline and is named by ariaLabel; the floating toolbar is role=toolbar named by toolbarLabel, reachable with Alt+F10, dismissed with Escape, with arrow-key navigation between buttons.
Buttons dropped into the toolbar must carry their own accessible name and be natively focusable (e.g. ww-button); a styled ww-div is not keyboard reachable.
Default colors meet WCAG AA: placeholder 4.8:1 and editor border 3.3:1; keyboard focus draws a :focus-visible ring controlled by focusRingColor.
